messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly Northline Care check-in. How have you been feeling since we last spoke? Any changes in your blood sugar or anything new going on?
Pretty okay I guess. Main thing is I'm flat out of my metformin. Pharmacy says they need a brand new prescription from my doctor before they'll touch it, and they're almost 40 miles away from me.

Got it — I'm logging that as a medication issue right now. Running out of metformin and needing a new script is something our nursing team has to handle, so I'm escalating this to them today. Just so you know, their median response time is currently 31 hours. They'll be the ones to coordinate with your doctor on the prescription.
Is there any way to get it delivered out here? I really can't make that drive without planning ahead.

I hear you — that's a real hassle. Delivery and transportation arrangements are outside what I'm able to help with, but I'd bring that up directly when the nurse contacts you. They may know options. Is there anything else on the health side I should pass along to them?
No that's about it. Just need to get back on my meds.
Understood. Your medication concern is flagged and the care team will follow up within about 31 hours. I'll check in with you again next week — hang in there.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
